title: The Paper Compass
author: Quentin Marchetti
blurb: Jonah Okonkwo, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
